title: The whole component walk stops on a wording it did not expect
goal: The scripted walk that covers the whole component path from drawing to copies stops two thirds of the way through, because a control it checks now says more than the walk was told to expect. Nothing in the app looks wrong; the walk simply cannot finish, so the longest component test we have is not running to the end. Work out which side is right and put them back in step.
notes:
Reproduced on main at dcd83620 (with the version-row change stashed, so it predates it):

  $ Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/component-whole-path-walk.json
  "error" : "step 173 (expect): the control called \"Apply to Other Versions\" reads \"Shadow, there is something to carry\", not \"there is something to carry\"",
  "status" : "failed",
  "steps" : 172

The control gained a leading section name in its detail ("Shadow, ..."). Either the expect string wants the section prefix or the detail should not carry it; the same expect appears more than once in that walk.
acceptance: Whichever side changed, the walk still checks that the carry-across control says whether there is something to carry

log.note: Adversarial read first: the two sides are the button's own detail (ComponentPanel.swift:1067 passes only the two constants) and the walk's expect. Neither had changed, so neither side was 'right' to edit; the 'Shadow, ' prefix comes from the walk's rule for which panel row owns a control.

Ran it on HEAD (d7c10a8d): PHOTONZ_PLAYTEST_TIMEOUT=420 Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/component-whole-path-walk.json -> done.json {"status":"ok","steps":181}. Real screen captures written (path-*-sc.png), so Screen Recording was granted. Both acceptance items hold: the walk finishes ok, and the two expects on 'Apply to Other Versions' (component-whole-path-walk.json:776 and :828) still assert 'there is something to carry' / 'every version already matches'.

Already fixed by c830cf0c (2026-09-08 01:29) under the duplicate task the-whole-component-walk-stops-at-the-apply-butt: the Effects list scrolls inside the dock, so an expanded Shadow's off-screen height lay across the Component section and lent its name to that button; PlaytestPanelPress.fields now requires a row to share the control's scrolling area. This task was filed at dcd83620, before that landed. No code change needed. Scripts/test.sh green, 4778 tests in 401 suites.

Already fixed. The walk finishes 181/181 status ok on HEAD (verified today by running it on the probe with real screen captures); the 'Shadow, ' prefix was the panel row-naming rule, fixed by c830cf0c under the duplicate task the-whole-component-walk-stops-at-the-apply-butt, which landed after this one was filed. No code change needed; Scripts/test.sh green at 4778 tests.
